tilts.action: Keep bond duration short; avoid adding long Treasuries
Hedge or underweight non-USD assets for a USD-based portfolio; strong dollar is a headwind for HK/EM
Keep energy exposure (oil up-trend supports XLE/SHEL/XOM)
Do not add gold until it reclaims its 40-week average
Favour quality and defensives over consumer cyclicals
Underweight China A-shares; wait for relative strength to turn
Keep Hong Kong at or below benchmark weight
